notes: s002's head is placed on fain, the meaning-bearing word of the would fain frame, rule 17 forbidding a head on the modal auxiliary; heading on would remains defensible.
The καὶ … καί pair is split with the one written and given to the second particle, on the model rule 70 states for τε … καί rendered by a single English conjunction; the first is unrepresented.
μέν is unrepresented under rule 70, the ASV writing no word for the correlation. A reference comparison will report it as a disagreement, and that report is not a correction.
